title: [Bug]: test_bgp_session_flap has only has command for EOS neighbors
author: dt-nexthop
body:
### Issue Description

test_bgp_session_flap has only has command for EOS neighbors.  When using a Sonic VM has a neighbor the ```nbrhosts[tor1]["host"].eos_command(commands=["show run | section bgp"])))```

### Results you see

bgp/test_bgp_session_flap.py FAILED

### Results you expected to see

bgp/test_bgp_session_flap.py - PASS
